claude.sample_unit: RoB records from recently published RCTs

links.outcome: Accuracy of clinician-verified vs raw LLM risk-of-bias judgments against reference standard
links.effect: Raw TRoB-1 accuracy 73.3%-73.9%; after verification 82.0%-84.5%. Verification did not change any correct judgment to incorrect; clinicians corrected 13 and 18 incorrect judgments.
links.quote: After verification, accuracy ranged from 82.0% (n=132) to 84.5% (n=136) and macro-F1 from 0.709 to 0.776.

links.outcome: Performance of clinicians using AI-assisted workflow versus raw AI output; overreliance
links.effect: Clinician-verified accuracy 82.0%-84.5% vs raw TRoB-1 73.3%-73.9%; high-RoB F1 rose from 0.600 to 0.784 and 0.571 to 0.821; no correct judgments made incorrect.
links.quote: The F1-score for judgments of high-RoB increased from 0.600 to 0.784 for clinician 1 and from 0.571 to 0.821 for clinician 2.

links.outcome: Fine-tuned model accuracy compared with base model on same data
links.effect: Raw TRoB-1 accuracy 73.3% to 73.9% versus 52.2% to 60.2% for the Gemma 2 base model.
links.quote: In independent clinician-assisted assessments using the same workflow, raw TRoB-1 accuracy ranged from 73.3% (n=118) to 73.9% (n=119), compared with 52.2% (n=84) to 60.2% (n=97) for the Gemma 2 base model.

unlisted_practices: Task-specific fine-tuning of open-weight LLM on domain data
Evidence-linked outputs with supporting quotations from source passages
Locally hosted web interface for reviewer verification
